response.sql:
WITH country_tallies AS (
    SELECT p.birth_country, COUNT(*) AS tally
    FROM player_college AS pc
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = pc.player_id
    GROUP BY p.birth_country
),
country_shares AS (
    SELECT birth_country, tally,
           CAST(tally AS REAL) / SUM(tally) OVER () AS share
    FROM country_tallies
),
above_average AS (
    SELECT tally, share,
           AVG(tally) OVER () AS average_tally
    FROM country_shares
)
SELECT SUM(tally) AS combined_tally,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(tally - average_tally) AS average_amount_above_average
FROM above_average
WHERE tally > average_tally;

assumptions.assumption: Each row in player_college counts as one college attendance; countries are grouped by the matched player's birth_country, including NULL if present. Shares use the total attendance tally across all countries.
